fact: The Malawi Electoral Commission's Chief Elections Officer said in a 5 June 2025 response that Sections 20 and 21 of the 2023 Elections Act limit voter-roll inspection to verification of entries at registration centres and regional offices.
source_slug: 2025-06-08 MEC Rejects Observer Coalition's Electronic Voter Register Access Request

fact: The Principal Secretary says the law makes the Malawi Electoral Commission recognise the national ID as the single source of truth for voter registration, after Parliament made it the only proof of identity.
The Malawi Electoral Commission said its Election Management System database held 7,202,756 valid voter records for the 2025 election, with fingerprint verification used for voter transfers.
The Malawi Electoral Commission announced biometric voter registration starting September 2024 in three phases, and has been demonstrating the Smartmatic-supplied registration devices.
MEC held inspection and verification of the voters' register on 30 and 31 May 2026 at registration centres and offered an electronic check through *2509# on TNM and Airtel networks.

The Malawi Electoral Commission gave all 23 political parties the electronic voters' register on 12 May 2025 and said it would deploy over 15,200 biometric voter identification devices scanning fingerprints against a preloaded biometric database.
MEC said the register inspection closed on 31 May 2025, with 479,115 voters verifying their details at centres and 605,217 using the USSD code *2509# as of 5 June.

Biometric Update reports that a national biometric voter registration exercise was in its final phase and ended on 11 December 2024, with the NRB promising an ID number within 24 hours of registration to applicants taking part.
